item.title: Derrick Hodge Unveils “Mind of a Dreamer,” a Genre-Blurring Suite with Nu Deco Ensemble
item.description: Derrick Hodge releases “Mind of a Dreamer,” a seven-movement suite with Nu Deco Ensemble blending jazz, hip-hop, R&B, and orchestral textures.

item.title: Watch Justin Meldal-Johnsen Hold Down Beck’s Odelay Era on 2 Meter Sessions (1999)
item.description: A long unseen 1999 Beck set from 2 Meter Sessions is now on YouTube, showcasing Justin Meldal Johnsen’s pocket on two Odelay era favorites.

item.title: Nevermore Reveals New Lineup, Shares First Footage of 2026 Return
item.description: Nevermore has revealed its new lineup, including bassist Semir Özerkan, and shared first rehearsal footage ahead of its 2026 return shows and ProgPower USA appearance.

item.title: Groove Podcast: Riccardo Oliva Interview: Bass, Fusion, and Touring with Matteo Mancuso
item.description: Riccardo Oliva joins Groove Podcast to talk bass, fusion, and life in Matteo Mancuso’s trio at the Montreal Jazz Festival.

item.title: Oteil Burbridge Expands the Jam: Oteil & Friends Announce 2026 Summer Tour
item.description: Oteil Burbridge has announced 2026 tour dates for Oteil & Friends, featuring Steve Kimock, Johnny Kimock, Lamar Williams Jr., and more. See the full schedule.

item.title: Watch MonoNeon Stretch the Groove on “Better Days Are Coming” at Blue Note LA
item.description: MonoNeon keeps it loose and funky on “Better Days Are Coming,” captured live at Blue Note LA.

item.title: NAMM 2026: Aguilar Supercharges Octamizer and TLC Compressor with DLX Upgrades
item.description: Aguilar debuts the Octamizer DLX and TLC DLX Compressor EQ at NAMM 2026. The new DLX pedals add DSP-powered tracking, octave-up capability, and 3-band EQ. Both are available now for $329.99.

item.title: Flea Reimagines Frank Ocean’s “Thinkin Bout You” as a Cinematic Bass & Trumpet Ballad
item.description: Flea has released an orchestral instrumental version of Frank Ocean’s “Thinkin Bout You,” the third single from his upcoming solo album Honora. Listen and see tour dates.

item.title: Live Fusion Pocket: Wes Stephenson Drives “Lotus” with the Mark Lettieri Group
item.description: On “Lotus,” the Mark Lettieri Group lean into groove, powered by Wes Stephenson’s 5 string bass, full bodied tone, and fluid blend of fingerstyle and slap technique.

item.title: Washburn Revives the Wing Series with the Return of the Scavenger ’78 Bass
item.description: Washburn has revived its Wing Series with the return of the Scavenger ’78 Bass. Featuring mahogany construction and a classic P-style pickup, the vintage-inspired model lands at $699.
